value.rationale: The new theorem converts the recent model’s catalogue of possible nonadjacent supports into a complete, parameter-robust prediction for the actually selected final support from every nonzero occupancy, proves exponential convergence instead of inferring it from stability calculations or finite trajectories, and extracts a nontrivial, biologically interpretable memory of the extinct intermediate species in exact terminal abundance. It provides a rigorous limit to which simulations can be compared, without claiming results for heterogeneous demographic parameters.
